dialogues.speaker: Siger
dialogues.text: Hey, can I make a wish to Lesser Lord Kusanali for some more valuable books to add to my collection?

dialogues.speaker: Siger
dialogues.text: Ever since I lost that batch of literary treasures, my luck's been awful.

dialogues.speaker: Siger
dialogues.text: Every book that's even slightly valuable gets reserved by the Akademiya first. They even take all the worthless ones.

dialogues.speaker: Siger
dialogues.text: What's that you say? I should just get a job at the House of Daena? ...Actually, don't tell me... Let me think it over... Do they hire foreigners there?
